lines.en: When they found the remains of the Mesozoic Mastodon,
they discovered what appeared to be the remains
of a Paleozoic amphibian in its jaws.
Maybe this should be more of a quiet game.
Joey, I left my watch on the counter last night.
It was right here. Where is it?
All right, well, come on. I'm late for work.
How do you know? You don't have a watch.
Guys, could you please just stop there on the ball
for one minute and just help me find it?
Oh, I don't know. Yeah, I can't do it.
Monica, whatever you do, do not drop that ball.
Yeah, we haven't dropped it in...
I'm not going to be able to make it into work today.
Wow, uh, for a second there,
I thought I was feeling better, but I'm not.
Almost three hours without dropping it.
That's quite a waste of time.
Monica, stop throwing it so hard.
You guys have been doing this for four hours?
No, no, no, don't do it.
It's really a three-person game, you know?
Rach, why won't they take it back?
Well, they said they would, but they would only give me store credit.
I mean, what am I going to do, get a thousand regular cats?
Look, if you want, you can keep it at our place until you find out what to do with it.
No, Mom, that's not the point.
I'm all scratched up, and I'm stuck with this stupid cat that looks like a hand.
The cat's made my eyes water.
Yeah, you almost overreacted to something.
We're closing in on ten hours.
I don't know who made you the boss, all right?
I made this game what it is.
There's some pizza at my place.
We can all eat with one hand, right?
All right, we can work out that name later.
Phoebe, it's six o'clock in the morning.
Come on, Gary's such a great guy.
Whatever the problem is, you can work it out.
Yeah, yeah, I'll be all right.
Nah, I don't feel like playing.
Just pretend that it didn't happen, OK?
Phoebe's not an official ball player.
I mean, only official ball players can drop the ball.
Phoebe, do you want to get some breakfast?
